title: Roku TV will not power on
shortDescription: TV unresponsive across TCL, Hisense, Onn, JVC Roku models.
fullDescription:
Roku TV is a co-branded platform - hardware comes from TCL, Hisense, Sharp, Westinghouse, JVC, Onn, etc. Power failures trace to the manufacturer's PSU board.

Diagnosis is the same regardless of brand - check capacitors, then main board.

fixSteps.title: Outlet check
fixSteps.instruction: Test outlet works.

fixSteps.title: Power drain
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug 5 minutes, hold power 30 seconds.

fixSteps.title: PSU inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Open back, check capacitors.

affectedModels: TCL Roku, Hisense Roku, Onn Roku, Sharp Roku, JVC Roku
videoSearchQuery: Roku TV won't turn on fix

faq.a: No - Roku is the OS; hardware is TCL/Hisense/etc.

title: Roku home / app frozen
fullDescription: Roku platform freezes due to memory pressure, channel crashes, or firmware issues. The Roku soft-reset combo (5x Home, 1x Up, 2x Rewind, 2x FF) reboots without unplugging.

fixSteps.title: Soft reset
fixSteps.instruction: Home 5x, Up 1x, Rewind 2x, FF 2x.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug 60 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Factory reset
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > System > Advanced > Factory Reset.

faq.a: Reboots Roku without erasing data - keeps account and channels.

title: HDMI input shows no signal
fullDescription: Roku TV no signal usually means wrong input or cable issue. HDMI Mode (Standard/Auto/HDMI 2.0) needs to be set per port for 4K HDR.

fixSteps.title: Switch input
fixSteps.instruction: Use Roku home and switch input tile.

fixSteps.title: Set HDMI Mode
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > TV inputs > HDMI Mode > HDMI 2.0 / Auto.

fixSteps.title: Replace cable
fixSteps.instruction: Use Ultra High Speed for 4K/120.

videoSearchQuery: Roku TV no signal HDMI fix

faq.a: Roku's term for full bandwidth mode for HDR/4K60.

title: Roku channel crashes or fails
fullDescription: Channels (Roku's term for apps) sometimes crash on launch due to channel update issues. Removing and re-adding the channel fixes most cases.

fixSteps.title: Restart Roku
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > System > System Restart.

fixSteps.title: Remove channel
fixSteps.instruction: Highlight channel, press *, Remove channel.

fixSteps.title: Re-add
fixSteps.instruction: Streaming Channels > search > Add channel.

faq.a: Yes if you remove channel - re-login when re-added.

title: Netflix network connection error
fullDescription: NW-2-5 on Roku TV means Netflix can't connect to its servers. Most cases are local network; sometimes Netflix channel needs reinstall.

fixSteps.title: Test network
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Network > Check connection.

fixSteps.title: Restart
fixSteps.instruction: System restart.

fixSteps.title: Re-add Netflix
fixSteps.instruction: Remove and re-add Netflix channel.

faq.a: Usually local network; if other channels work, retry network reset first.

title: Roku TV no audio
fullDescription: Roku TV audio issues are usually output mode or Atmos passthrough mismatch. Roku doesn't decode Dolby Atmos for built-in speakers - needs external Atmos device.

fixSteps.title: Audio mode
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Audio > Audio mode > Stereo.

fixSteps.title: S/PDIF and ARC
fixSteps.instruction: Set to PCM-Stereo if no Atmos device.

fixSteps.title: System restart
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > System > System Restart.

faq.a: Roku passes Atmos but TV speakers can't decode - use Stereo PCM.

title: Roku 1-Touch Play / CEC not working
fullDescription: Roku TV's CEC implementation is called 1-Touch Play and System Audio Control. Failures usually mean these features are off.

fixSteps.title: Enable CEC
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > System > Control other devices (CEC) > Enable 1-Touch + System Audio.

fixSteps.title: Enable partner CEC
fixSteps.instruction: Anynet+, Bravia Sync, etc.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: All off 60 seconds.

faq.a: Lets TV remote control connected AVR/soundbar volume via CEC.

title: Roku OS update did not install
fullDescription: Roku updates are usually reliable but can fail with weak Wi-Fi. Roku doesn't offer USB updates - if persistent, factory reset or contact support.

fixSteps.title: Wired connection
fixSteps.instruction: Use Ethernet.

fixSteps.title: System restart
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > System > System Restart.

fixSteps.title: Factory reset
fixSteps.instruction: Last resort.

faq.q: Can I roll back Roku update?
faq.a: No - Roku doesn't offer downgrades.

title: Roku remote unresponsive
fullDescription: Roku ships two remote types: Simple IR remotes (no voice) and Voice Remotes (Bluetooth/Wi-Fi). Voice remotes pair via WPS-like process.

fixSteps.title: Replace batteries
fixSteps.instruction: Fresh AAAs.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair voice remote
fixSteps.instruction: Hold pairing button in battery compartment 5 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Use Roku app
fixSteps.instruction: Phone app as backup remote.

faq.a: Inside battery compartment of voice remote.

title: Vertical lines on display
fullDescription: Vertical lines on Roku TV are a hardware issue from the manufacturer (TCL, Hisense, etc.) - not a Roku OS problem. T-CON board or panel needs service.

fixSteps.title: Confirm internal
fixSteps.instruction: Lines on Roku home confirm internal fault.

fixSteps.title: Reseat ribbons
fixSteps.instruction: Open back, reseat T-CON cables.

fixSteps.title: Replace T-CON
fixSteps.instruction: Match part number.

faq.q: Is this a Roku OS issue?
faq.a: No - it's hardware from the TV manufacturer.

title: Roku Error 009
shortDescription: Roku TV error 009: TV connected to router but not to internet.
fullDescription: Roku error 009 indicates the router is online but cannot reach Roku servers. Most cases clear by re-running Network setup with the correct Wi-Fi password and a stable router.

fixSteps.title: Re-enter Wi-Fi
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Network > Set up connection > Wireless; type password carefully.

fixSteps.title: Reboot router
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug router 60 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Move closer
fixSteps.instruction: Bring TV within 15 ft of router for setup.

fixSteps.title: System restart
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > System > Power > System restart.

faq.a: Roku TV error 009: TV connected to router but not to internet.

title: Netflix NETFLIX UI-800-3
shortDescription: Netflix app shows error NETFLIX UI-800-3 on Roku TV, usually cache-related.
fullDescription: Error NETFLIX UI-800-3 indicates a cache problem between the Netflix app and its servers. Most cases clear with a sign-out, app reload, or network reset. Persistent errors may need firmware update or factory reset.

causes.cause: Stale app cache or expired session token
Outdated TV firmware or app version

fixSteps.title: Restart TV
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug TV for 60 seconds then power back on to clear memory.

fixSteps.title: Sign out and back in
fixSteps.instruction: Open Netflix, sign out, then sign back in to refresh the session token.

fixSteps.title: Check network
fixSteps.instruction: Run network test in TV settings; reboot router if speeds are low.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Support > Software Update; install any pending update.

fixSteps.title: Reinstall app
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the Netflix app from the home screen and reinstall from the store.

whenToCallPro: Only if errors persist after factory reset.

faq.q: Is NETFLIX UI-800-3 a TV hardware fault?
faq.a: No — it is an app/network error and clears with sign-out, reinstall, or firmware update.

title: Roku OS Update Stuck
shortDescription: Software update hangs at a percentage.
fullDescription: Roku updates can stall on flaky Wi-Fi. A wired connection or system restart with a forced check-for-update typically completes it.

fixSteps.title: Wait 30 minutes
fixSteps.instruction: Let it finish if recently started.

fixSteps.title: Force restart
fixSteps.instruction: Hold power on TV.

fixSteps.title: Check for update
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > System > System update > Check now.

faq.a: Software update hangs at a percentage.
